title: Plastidic Nitrate Reductase (NR) Activation vs Petiole Nitrate Storage under Spectral Light Steering
author: Dr. vmffkxhs2362
abstract: Accumulation of NO3- in petiole vacuoles poses health risks in hydroponic leafy greens. We investigated light-driven activation of plastidic Nitrate Reductase (NR, EC 1.7.1.1) in hydroponic spinach under pre-harvest end-of-day (EOD) lighting treatments. Adding 30 μmol/m²/s supplemental blue light 4 hours prior to harvest accelerated NR dephosphorylation, reducing tissue nitrate below the EU regulatory limit of 3500 mg/kg.
key_findings: EOD supplemental blue light decreased petiole NO3- concentration by 41.5% within 4 hours.
NR activation state increased from 32.8% in control to 88.4% under blue LED irradiation.
Glutamine synthetase (GS2) transcript abundance increased 3.1-fold, driving ammonium assimilation.
